# Raw data for resting state functional MRI in awake mice using a CryoProbe

## SUBJECTS
8 male adult C57BL/6J mice (JAX Mice)

## Scans
Bruker 7T MRI at CIEA, Japan

Measurements: August 22 - October 27, 2016

### T2w Anatomical
2D RARE
resolution: 0.75 x 0.75 x 3 mm^3
matrix: 256 x 256 x 52

### T2*w GE-EPI
15 runs
GE-EPI
resolution: 0.2 x 0.2 x 0.75 mm^3
matrix: 64 x 64 x 18
TR: 1.5 s
TE: 15 ms
Volume: 400 without dummy scan
scan time: 10 min

## Preprocess
The scale dimension unit was x10 of naive space.
